ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Virtual Network Device Modified or Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description:
Identifies when a virtual network device is being modified or deleted.
This can be a network interface, network virtual appliance, virtual hub, or virtual router.
 Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKINTERFACES\/TAPCONFIGURATIONS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKINTERFACES\/TAPCONFIGURATIONS\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKINTERFACES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKINTERFACES\/JOIN\/ACTION" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKINTERFACES\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKVIRTUALAPPLIANCES\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/NETWORKVIRTUALAPPLIANCES\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/VIRTUALHUBS\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/VIRTUALHUBS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/VIRTUALROUTERS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.NETWORK\/VIRTUALROUTERS\/DELETE")
